scope: Local name-only audit of reference names without a matched point/polygon at the earlier checkpoint. No network requests or new boundary validation. These declarations are suggestions for the root catalogue alias registry, not mutations of that registry.

documentedAliasSuggestions.name: Akadémiakert
documentedAliasSuggestions.reason: Minor spelling/word-formation variant in the historical municipal reference inventory; the ArcGIS and selected catalogue use Akadémiakert.

documentedAliasSuggestions.name: Nagycsere
documentedAliasSuggestions.reason: The reference inventory explicitly flags Nagycserte as a transcription anomaly; the same municipal-part series and source polygons use Nagycsere. Keep the anomalous source spelling as a searchable alias, not another area.

documentedAliasSuggestions.name: Nagyerdőtölgyes
documentedAliasSuggestions.reason: The reference inventory explicitly flags this source spelling as a transcription anomaly; the source polygon and current catalogue use the ordinary tölgyes spelling.

documentedAliasSuggestions.name: Tócórét
documentedAliasSuggestions.reason: Accent-only reference transcription variant of the same named Tócó area.

documentedAliasSuggestions.name: KISZ-lakótelep
documentedAliasSuggestions.reason: The OSM named-place source explicitly has alt_name=Ifjúsági lakótelep; the municipal list itself supplies KISZ parenthetically.

tentativeNotAutomaticallyApplied.reason: Likely reference transcription anomaly; local OSM has Úrihegy but no explicit alias binding was found in this quick audit.
Likely shortened name, but Gunaras may denote a broader planning/local area. Preserve the distinction unless another source explicitly equates them.

doNotTreatAsSimpleAliases: Composite planning areas such as Andráshida – Gébárt – Apátfa, Diósgyőr – Berekalja – Majláth and Toponár – Répáspuszta – Fészerlakpuszta – Deseda represent useful parent areas rather than duplicates of each component.
Kámoni kertváros/Herényi kertváros and other planning-scheme names may differ in extent from Kámon/Herény; overlapping parent and component outlines can coexist.
Külterületek and directional exterior-area labels are search/planning schemes, not ordinary spelling variants of a named neighbourhood.
Budapest Orbánhegy in district XII and the distinct district-XXIII Orbánhegy must retain district-qualified identity; equal literal names alone do not imply duplication.
